name: cryptoliveleak-earthquake-assurance-lab
description: Independent software-assurance reference implementation: C++ decision component, NATS JetStream services, fault-injection integration tests, code metrics, and reviewer dashboard.

scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run assure
scripts.test:sanitized: npm run build:sanitized && DECISION_ENGINE=build/alert_decision_san node --test tests/decision_engine.test.mjs tests/browser_model.test.mjs
scripts.sbom: mkdir -p reports && npm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx --omit dev > reports/sbom.cdx.json
